summary: Final verification for Electron packaging. All 15 iteration-4 backend tests PASS (covering removed /api/seed, unique barcode constraint on create+update, dental seed idempotency, 20 categories present, supplier CRUD, product CRUD with new fields, OS-XXXXXX generate-barcode idempotent, /scan flow, with_usage fields, reorder rule qty<=min, dashboard stats, alerts, and server_local.py SQLite importability). SQLite backend init_db() verified: creates 4 tables and seeds 20 dental categories. Frontend thoroughly tested — branding 'Opéra santé' everywhere, NO 'Charger la démo' button, NO 'Commandes' nav link, 'Étiquettes' present, hotkeys S/I/C work, /inventaire column order correct + inline 'Générer' button works (creates OS-XXXXXX), Export CSV button present, /commander shows low-stock items grouped by supplier with Imprimer + Commander buttons, /mouvements has new Entrée/Sortie buttons, /etiquettes has format+size toggles, /scanner has auto-focus input + manual button, ProductDialog has Marque + Scanner + 'Lien du produit' fields and NO Unité/Emplacement. All test data cleaned up. DB state preserved: only 20 dental categories, no products/suppliers/movements.

minor.issue: Dead/broken: calls reorder_suggestions(payload.horizon_days) but reorder_suggestions() takes no args and payload is undefined. Unreachable from UI so harmless, but should be removed or fixed.

logger used on line 740 before logging.basicConfig/logger definition on lines 759-763. Wrapped in try/except so no visible failure, but the warning would be lost. Low severity — move logger init above on_startup.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: unique barcode partial index uses partialFilterExpression {$gt: ''} — correctly excludes empty-barcode products. DuplicateKeyError caught and re-raised as 400 with French message. OK.
server.py is 769 lines — still a candidate to split into routers/ for future maintenance.
Legacy /app/backend/server.py /api/reorder/auto and /api/orders endpoints are no longer exposed by UI but remain callable. reorder_auto is outright broken (TypeError).

server_local.py (SQLite alternative for Electron) is 772 lines and mirrors server.py endpoint-by-endpoint — import + init_db verified, tables created, 20 categories seeded. Uses OPERA_DB_PATH env var or ~/.opera-sante/opera.db.
CORS still allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject combined; fine today (no auth) and Electron is local.
Dashboard stats, reorder/suggestions enrich products with individual Mongo queries (N+1). Acceptable for small dental cabinet catalogues but note for scale.
